title: RunRecord
description: The aggregatable envelope for one unit of work (0005 §1). Resident-authored — evaluations are never self-asserted (0001). Cohort key (scope, goal_hash) is EH's key, depth-agnostic. occurred_at buckets in universe-time; cost is physical (0004 §1).

agent.description: Who did the work — the subject, never the author.

goal_hash.description: The cohort key's second half — (scope, goal_hash), lifted from EH.

skill_ref.description: Which skill/version was exercised (0001), if any.

scores.description: Per-objective scores against the tier's objective vector (0004 §3). floor_breached marks a never-trade-off objective violated in this run.

cost.description: Physical spend — wall-clock side of the two-clock split.

run_ref.description: Opaque trace ref — the full run detail at the owning tier (pointer, not payload).

context_hash.description: Locked 2026-07-02 (0007): the ResolvedContext this run executed under — 'what rules governed this agent' is a lookup, not an investigation.

author.description: The resident (steward/judge) that wrote this — never the agent grading itself (0001).

ObjectiveStat.description: Sufficient statistics per objective — the monoid element (0005 §2). The Beta prior is applied ONCE at report time (merging posteriors would double-count it).

StatBundle.description: The monoid (0005 §2): merge is component-wise, associative, with the empty bundle as identity. Everything a tier needs to score, price, and trust a cohort — no raw records travel.

compliance.description: Locked 2026-07-02: any floor breach anywhere ⇒ 'breached' — flagged, never averaged away; the mean stays honest.

RollUp.description: A signed, content-addressed aggregate for a cohort × universe-time bucket (0005 §5). Composable: contributors may be RunRecords or child RollUps — the stats are identical either way (the monoid law, tested).

bucket.description: Universe-time (0004): the season, the quarter — the same monoid.

contributors.description: Signed content-addressed pointers (the locked roll-up mechanism) — RunRecords or child RollUps.

supersedes.description: Late arrivals re-aggregate by superseding — annotate, never rewrite.
